preconditions.description: The number of intersections n is between 1 and 3000 inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 0 and 30000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct intersections a_i and b_i, both within the range 1 to n.
The number of roads listed is exactly m.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for a, b, c, d in rhombi if (a, b) in roads and (b, c) in roads and (a, d) in roads and (d, c) in roads and b != d)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct damn rhombi, where each rhombus is defined by four intersections a, b, c, d such that there are direct roads (a, b), (b, c), (a, d), and (d, c), and b is not equal to d.
